term_note_fil: Ang mga opisyal ng barangay at SK na nahalal sa BSKE noong Oktubre 30, 2023 ay naglilingkod pa rin hanggang Oktubre 2026. Inilipat muna ng RA 12232 (nilagdaan noong Agosto 2025) ang BSKE mula Disyembre 2025 patungong Nobyembre 2, 2026; pagkatapos, kinansela ng RA 12326, na nilagdaan noong Setyembre 24, 2026, ang halalan sa Nobyembre 2026, itinakda ang susunod na BSKE sa ikalawang Lunes ng Nobyembre 2028 (Nobyembre 13, 2028), at ginawang limang taon ang termino ng mga opisyal ng barangay/SK, kaya mananatili sa puwesto hanggang noon ang mga nahalal noong 2023. Kinansela ng Comelec ang mga aktibidad sa BSKE 2026 noong Setyembre 25, 2026; nakabinbin pa sa Korte Suprema ang mga petisyon laban sa batas (hindi pa ibinabasura hanggang Oktubre 13, 2026).
term_note_en: Barangay and SK officials elected in the October 30, 2023 BSKE are still serving in October 2026. RA 12232 (signed August 2025) first moved the BSKE from December 2025 to November 2, 2026; then RA 12326, signed September 24, 2026, cancelled the November 2026 polls, set the next BSKE for the second Monday of November 2028 (November 13, 2028), and fixed barangay/SK terms at five years, so 2023-elected officials keep their posts until then. Comelec cancelled 2026 BSKE activities on September 25, 2026; petitions against the law are pending before the Supreme Court (not junked as of Oct 13, 2026).
general_notes: Barangay officials (Punong Barangay, SK Chairperson, Sangguniang Barangay members) and hall telephone numbers come from the DILG Barangay Information System officials directory (dilg.gov.ph/barangay-officials-directory), a self-reported government database; all barangay values stay verify:true. Palatiw lists no Punong Barangay in that database.
The DILG database shows no hall street addresses, so hall_address is empty.
Pasig City Hall operates from a Temporary City Hall at Bridgetowne, E. Amang Rodriguez Ave., Rosario; new city hall expected 2027 (Philstar 2026-08-03).
City trunkline (02) 8643-1111 confirmed in multiple 2025 charters; city hotline (02) 8643-0000.
Ex-officio members (Liga ng mga Barangay and SK Federation presidents) follow the Pasig City Government page.
The Public Information Office head is not listed because no source was found.
